label: Arcade
prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One original tall 1:2 portrait photograph-style environment background, approximately 1024 x 2048. Subject: an immersive neon arcade seen straight-on at a premium upright arcade cabinet with a real large portrait-oriented gaming display. The cabinet's physical glass display occupies about x9–91% and y10–73% of the frame, in a slim dark frame with subtle cyan and magenta edge lighting. The idle game display contains only a subdued indigo starfield/nebula and faint pixel-like glow, with realistic glass reflections, no characters, score, text, menus or icons. The center must stay low contrast for a live conversation to be added later. At the top, a compact believable illuminated arcade marquee, mainly abstract colored artwork, no commercial game brands. Narrow background glimpses contain neighboring machine marquees on the left and a softly lit prize counter with plush prizes on the right. The bottom y77–95% is the actual cabinet control deck, rich matte charcoal and brushed metal, with a long clean dark-glass inset strip near its top for a future typing bar, and broad empty central space below for small controls. Put a real joystick and a few colored tactile buttons only at the outer corners, not across the clean center. Light wear on the control deck, authentic hardware, glass, neon reflections, deep saturated-but-believable arcade photography, dimensional cabinet construction. No humans blocking the screen, no phone device or app frame, no floating labels, no conversation text or message bubbles, no watermark. Prioritize a large readable physical screen, not a distant view of the whole room.
description: Cyan-and-magenta arcade cabinet with a broad portrait display, tactile joystick deck, neighboring marquees and a prize counter.
packaging: JPEG quality90; no crop or creative edits. Thumbnail resized proportionally to 240px wide.
